summary: Refactored Gizmo's workspace profile and extension handling to remove workspace-type auto-detection and to make the built-in Default profile editable as a temporary override that reverts when values match the canonical default. Gizmo extensions are installed globally and manually enabled per workspace; user-created and extension-provided profiles continue to work.
decisions: Remove all workspace-type auto-detection; Gizmo extensions are installed globally and manually enabled per project.
Make the built-in Default profile editable by treating any change as a temporary override; when overridden values equal the canonical default, revert to the actual default.
User-created ('new') profiles continue to behave as persistent profiles distinct from the temporary-default override.
Removed unused helpers: the `extensionFor` function in agent-server extension registry and the `originLabel` function in WorkspaceConfigurePanel.
errors: agent-server tests projects/project-catalog.test.ts failed: 2 cases ('stores the selected workspace integrations', 'detects a Svelte app nested in a monorepo') expected `detected: true` but received `detected: false` because auto-detection was removed; updated test expectations to `detected: false`.
